name: AIRI Factorio Server (Swarm-Capable NPC v8)
author: noreply@ttlouis.space
description: Swarm-capable AIRI Factorio preview. Installs the validated multi-NPC Autorio runtime and hardened v8 supervisor. The bundled chat/LLM loop remains single-NPC while swarm Blackboard coordination APIs are staged for rollout. Loopback-only RCON is managed by the supervisor.

installation.script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Generated AIRI Factorio swarm-capable standalone-NPC v8 installer loader.
# Immutable source: deploy/pterodactyl/payload-src/installer.sh
set -Eeuo pipefail
umask 077

EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA256="feb286960a9d22d01d82efde52634022a83e3369a0af02c00d8059ff19ce6940"
URL="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TTLouis/airi-factorio/$REF/deploy/pterodactyl/payload-src/installer.sh"
TMP="$(mktemp)"
log() { printf '[AIRI bootstrap] %s\n' "$*"; }
fail() { log "ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 78; }
cleanup() { local code=$?; trap - EXIT; rm -f -- "$TMP"; exit "$code"; }
trap cleanup EXIT
trap 'exit 130' INT
trap 'exit 143' TERM HUP
for tool in bash curl sha256sum awk mktemp rm; do command -v "$tool" >/dev/null || fail "Missing installer loader tool: $tool"; done
curl --fail --location --retry 8 --retry-delay 5 --retry-max-time 240 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 900 --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' "$URL" --output "$TMP" || fail 'Unable to download pinned AIRI installer source'
ACTUAL_SOURCE_SHA256="$(sha256sum "$TMP" | awk '{print $1}')"
[[ "$ACTUAL_SOURCE_SHA256" == "$EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA256" ]] || fail 'Pinned AIRI installer source checksum mismatch'
if [[ "${1:-}" == '--verify-only' ]]; then log "Pinned payload verified at $REF; installation was not run."; exit 0; fi
[[ $# == 0 ]] || fail 'Only --verify-only is supported as a loader argument.'
log "Using immutable installer payload $REF"
bash "$TMP"

variables.name: AIRI Actor Mode
variables.description: Controlled actor mode. The v8 egg currently starts the chat supervisor on one standalone NPC while the installed Autorio mod is swarm-capable.

variables.name: AIRI Chat Player
variables.description: Optional exact in-game player name allowed to issue !airi chat requests. This does not control that player character.

variables.name: OpenAI API Key
variables.description: Provider credential. Kept environment-only and never written to airi-config.json.

variables.name: AI Model
variables.description: OpenAI-compatible model identifier used by AIRI.

variables.name: Provider Base URL
variables.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL. Remote endpoints must use HTTPS.

variables.name: Save File Name
variables.description: Save under /saves. Leave blank to use the newest existing save or create airi-world.zip.

variables.name: Shutdown Timeout (ms)
variables.description: Graceful Factorio save/stop timeout before forced termination.

variables.name: Factorio Version
variables.description: Factorio 2.0 headless version: latest, experimental, or exact 2.0.x.
